rules: Top 3 in the Metropolitan or a wild card

headings.leadersBlurb: These two lead the East divisions. Everyone else is chasing the other six berths.
headings.pathsBlurb: Finish top three in the Metropolitan, or be one of the two best remaining teams in the East.
headings.footer: Updated from the NHL’s public API. Not affiliated with the NHL or the Penguins.
headings.footerTiny: Eight teams in the conference qualify: the top three in each division and two wild cards. A regulation win and an overtime win are both two points. The playoff percentage is a season simulation from points percentage and home ice. It is not a betting line.
headings.conclusion: The Pittsburgh Penguins have been mathematically eliminated from the Stanley Cup playoffs.
headings.rootingBlurb: Win odds use the same points model as the playoff card. Not a betting line, and not a live in-game number.

narrative.headline: Puck drop in 2 days
narrative.blurb: The Penguins open at Philadelphia on Wed, Sep 30 · 7:30 PM. A full-season simulation gives them a 60.9% chance to still be playing in April. Last spring they were in, 3 up on the Metropolitan top three.

third.label: Days to opening night
third.note: Exhibition games do not count. The standings start at zero on opening night.

playoffOdds.note: Full season, simulated from last year's points percentage shrunk toward .500, plus home ice, on this year's schedule. About 23% of games go past regulation. The number moves once this season's points replace last year's. Not a betting line.

kpis.label: ROW
kpis.hint: Regulation plus overtime wins. Shootout wins do not count.
